scope: Fix for the supplied v4 GPU failure, not certification of a full v5 GPU run.

Keep early CSV publication, diagnostic logs, per-answer checkpoints and partial-result export from v4.

Verify constrained retries retain real available labels and all status choices.
Run actual tiny random-weight Qwen image generation through the repair path with an empty figure schema.

limitations: CPU regression tests and tiny random-weight model forwards are not a pretrained 7B GPU run or a model-quality score.
